mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals economic distress and weak consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and industrial production indicate strengthening economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and INDPRO fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects improving supply chain conditions and corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods during the post-recession recovery phase when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales growth (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 216.0 signals potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 216.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strengthening labor market, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1) in the early recovery phase signals sustained economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods during the early recovery phase when GDPC1 is positive.
